name: Pharmacology & Toxicology
summary: How drugs and toxins act on the body and how the body handles them, plus how new medicines are discovered and tested.

topics.name: Drug targets: receptors, enzymes, ion channels and transporters
Pharmacodynamics: dose-response, agonists, antagonists, efficacy and potency
Pharmacokinetics: absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion
Compartment models, half-life and dosing regimens
Drug metabolism and cytochrome P450 enzymes
Principles of toxicology: dose makes the poison, LD50 and risk assessment
Drug discovery and development: target to clinical trials
Adverse effects, drug interactions and pharmacovigilance
